name: Wisdom Emmanuel Praise
role: Senior Frontend Engineer, Frontend Platform & Architecture
summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 7+ years building B2B web applications, micro-frontends, and UI platforms. Drives frontend architecture across distributed Agile/Scrum teams through ADRs, builds design systems, partners with designers to turn Figma designs into responsive, accessible UI, runs technical hiring and code review, and has shipped production Agentic AI/LLM features using LangChain and MCP. Deep hands-on experience in React, Vue 3, and TypeScript, focused on performance, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA, BFSG), and developer tooling.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
experience.context: Enterprise digital asset management and omnichannel publishing platform, used by ecommerce, retail and media brands.
highlights: Designed the Frontend Builder, a modular platform for assembling customer-specific UIs from shared components. It now runs at 10+ enterprise customers, and new custom UIs take a few weeks instead of months.

Wrote the ADR for a five-layer feature architecture (view → use case → repository → service → adapter). It is now the standard in 13 product modules, and because each layer can be tested on its own, the cause of a production bug is usually found within a day instead of several days.
Set up Import Maps so 30+ micro-frontends share a single React/vendor runtime. Bundle size stayed flat as new frontends were added.
Built the MCP server that exposes asset management, metadata editing and publishing to LLM agents: 35 tools, permission-scoped per user, live at 4 customers.
Made WCAG 2.2 AA and BFSG compliance part of code review and the Definition of Done for an 11-person team, with Playwright accessibility checks in CI.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
experience.context: Industrial robotics and automation; web-based robot programming tooling (DIONE).
highlights: Led a 7-person frontend engineering unit in Scrum sprints to deliver DIONE, a web-based IDE for industrial robot programming, working directly with backend, hardware and product squads.
Engineered a real-time 3D configuration dashboard using Three.js (TresJS), reducing manual robotic setup from days of handwritten script to a few hours.
Enforced frontend profiling and asset optimizations (code splitting, lazy loading, state memoization) to keep complex 3D rendering responsive.
Built Vitest and Playwright test pipelines that gated every merge request, reducing escaped production defects by 20% over 200+ releases.
Directed release management via GitLab CI/CD, using feature flags for staged rollouts and zero-downtime hotfixes.
Ran technical hiring for the frontend team: designed the coding challenges and evaluation process, and helped hire 2 engineers into the 7-person unit.

experience.title: Frontend Engineer (Tech Lead, Domain Intelligence squad)
experience.context: Cybersecurity and digital risk protection SaaS.
highlights: Headed a 5-engineer Scrum squad building the FYEO Domain Intelligence platform, implementing 50+ Figma screens with the design team and delivering real-time threat dashboards via WebSockets that cut manual analyst investigation times by 25%.
Shipped a secure phishing-detection Chrome extension, scaling to over 5,000 registered accounts and 1,000+ daily active installations.
Raised frontend test coverage from 10% to 80% by integrating React Testing Library and Jest suites into production deployment branches.
Established formal team code review guidelines and structured technical mentorship paths to speed up junior developer delivery.

experience.title: Frontend Engineer
highlights: Delivered two high-scale social investment platforms (NASIMS and IDEC) from Figma designs to production, serving 2M+ citizens and migrating critical manual operations off legacy systems.
Overhauled the national vehicle registration engine (VREG), handling 1.5M+ entries a year, cutting average response time by roughly 40% and integrating PCI-compliant payment gateways.
Introduced Next.js Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) to meet Core Web Vitals targets, reducing average page load times across public portals by 40%.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Created school management software, interactive kiosk apps, and digital payment frameworks (VUVAA); balanced part-time delivery with a university degree (Mar 2017 – Dec 2019) before moving to a full-time engineering schedule.

education.school: Federal University of Technology, Minna, Nigeria
education.note: First Class Honours (4.65/5.0). Degree officially recognized in Germany via the Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB / anabin).

workAuthorization: Permanent residence (Niederlassungserlaubnis): unrestricted right to work in Germany, no visa sponsorship or employer approval required. Open to Munich-based, hybrid, and remote roles in Germany.
